findings.message: Each ~44px-wide block stacks three lines; the service line renders at roughly 9px and the in-block start time at roughly 7px in low-contrast gray, so the block's secondary content is hard to read at a glance. The start time also duplicates the hour grid, adding density without information. Proposal: Drop the in-block start time and keep two lines (name + service) at ≥11px, or widen the block/selected-day column so the three lines can use the app's 12–13px body scale; the row position already conveys the time.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-list.default.png — 周三 column blocks at x≈150–198 (张女士 10:00, 李女士 14:00, 王女士 16:30, 赵女士 18:00), y≈300–660

findings.message: The same 'ghost' emphasis renders as a bare gray text link beside the customer input and as an outlined chip on the detail pages, so the customer-picker control looks like a label rather than a tappable action and the component language is inconsistent across pages. Proposal: Give 选择 the same outlined ghost-button treatment (36–40px tall, 1px border, 8–10px radius) used for the detail-page ghost actions, and keep a single ghost style across the app.
findings.evidence: screenshots/appointment-form.default.png — 客户 row at y≈90–127, the 选择 action at x≈329–356 has no button chrome; compare the outlined ghost chips on customer-detail.default.png at y≈514–535

findings.message: The two row groups share the same ListRow structure but only 我的预约 rows show a trailing chevron; the 待回访 rows read as static text, so the same row pattern carries two different affordances within one page. Proposal: Give 待回访 rows the same trailing '›' if they open the callback form, or make them visually static so all tappable rows in the page share one affordance.
